nom: Naked Sundays CabanaClear Water Gel Serum Sunscreen SPF 50

avis.texte: I absolutely love this stuff! I hate the sticky texture of regular sunscreens, this just goes on like a serum! Its lightweight and i cant even feel it. Its like im wearing nothing on my face. I will never stop using it

Coming from someone who is acne-prone and has sensitive skin this has been the only sunscreen that has not broken me out. It has a nice consistency, not too liquidy or too thick and leaves zero white cast. However, coming from someone who prefers to look more on the glowly side, this is too much glow. My face looks like a disco ball and it lasts all day. Its not the kind of glow i was aiming for. As someone with acne, it made my pimples (and the rest of my face) look more greasy than I actually was, but its the only sunscreen that doesn't cause me to break out. I really wish it wasnt so glowly or if they'd at least come out with a matte version. Otherwise it is a great product!

This goes on like a serum, absorbed quickly with no white cast. Very slight sunscreen smell. Skin feels like there is nothing on, and doesn't have that really heavy icky feeling that sunscreens can have. Has a very nice matte finish,which I love. I've tried a lot of different face spfs, this is by far my new favorite.
I'm so psyched to finally find a good every day spf that does not sting my eyes! It also is very easy to rub in and feels light weight.

avis.titre: I feel like I've gone crazy
avis.texte: Everyone is saying this isnt oily or greasy but it looks like I've patted my face with a cheese pizza. The bottle also literwlly describes this as semi matte but this is the FURTHEST thing from that. Its very shiny and emphasizes my texture. And let me be clear I'm fine with a glowy moment, my tinted moisturizers are always on the dewy side but this is next level and I havent even put anything else on my face yet. Will be returning this.

This product makes me WANT to use sunscreen daily - no eye burn, leaves my skin SO soft, natural glow finish & light weight! Truly everything I have wanted in a sunscreen. I felt it was worth every penny and immediately ordered a second bottle before I finished my first!

avis.titre: Perfect if you hate the feel of sunscreen!
avis.texte: i decided to try out this product because i dont like how regular sunscreens feel on my skin. i usually feel greasy and sticky so i would always avoid sun protection. this one has been a life changer!! it feels like a lightweight moisturizer / serum. it isnt stickey at all and there is almost zero smell.

avis.titre: Sunscreen For People Who Hate Sunscreen
avis.texte: This product has completely changed my opinion of wearing sunscreen. I have avoided it for years because they're greasy, break me out, or don't wear well under makeup. This sunscreen is smooth and hydrating, doesn't sting my eyes or irritate my skin in any way. As another reviewer mentioned, this product makes me want to wear sunscreen! I haven't skipped a day since I bought it because I love it so much. It wears well under any foundation I've tried, regardless if it's water based or or silicone based. What I love most is that it's hydrating enough for my combination skin to wear alone under my foundation without any additional skincare.

Love this sunscreen. I have acne-prone, sensitive skin and could never find a sunscreen that didnt break me out, but this one doesnt! It is very glowy though. Definitely a bit too much for my personal preference, but the glow last all day. Wish there was a matte version.

This meets all of my needs. It's cruelty free, and it's vegan. I don't understand companies that are still testing on animals. I think it's cruel in a horrible business model. This has a lovely texture, its smooth and silky, a perfect texture for my skin. I am combination with a really oily T. Zone that breaks out but my cheeks are super dry. This feels great and balancing and I will continue using it.

I have zero complaints, ive used the entire bottle and will be repurchasing. I started out with the small bottle just to see if i would like it, and i will be purchasing the bigger bottle. I wore it pretty much everyday and it lasted me from may-july. I only did one application a day though so if youre the type of person to do multiple applications it will last less. Only complaint is the PRICE.

I went around the store looking for a Sunscreen that didn't feel like it would worsen oily skin. This one was perfect, the watery consistency felt like it absorbed into my skin. Favorite sunscreen so far!

avis.titre: Made me actually want to wear spf
avis.texte: I have very oily and acne-prone skin, so let me tell you, I used to HATE wearing sunscreen with a passion. It always burned my eyes, broke me out, made me look like a glazed donut (in a bad way), or made my makeup pill and slide right off (OR all of the above). I got this sunscreen and IMMEDIATELY fell in love with it. I mean, it was too good to be true. It feels weightless, never burns my eyes, doesn't have a yucky sunscreen smell, and gives me a gorgeous glowy base without making me look oily. PLUS no white cast because it's a gel. I truly cannot say enough good things about this product, and I don't think I could ever go back to another spf. Is it pricey? Yes. Is it worth it? A hundred times yes. I actually look forward to putting this on every day- and I wish I was kidding. It is now my favorite product in my routine. If you haven't found that spf you are in love with yet, TRY THIS ONE.

The Naked Sundays Cabana Clear Sunscreen has become one of my most‑used sunscreens. Lightweight with a very pleasant texture Absorbs quickly with no greasy or heavy feel Works beautifully under makeup — no pilling or slipping Leaves skin comfortable, not shiny or sticky I especially appreciate the compact, well‑designed container, which makes it ideal for keeping in a bag for on‑the‑go reapplication. It's one of the few sunscreens I actually enjoy using consistently. Easy, wearable, and well thought out.

avis.titre: My favorite sunscreen!  a forever purchase
avis.texte: I love this serum sunscreen. Plays nice under makeup and SPF 50 for great sun proctection. Doesn't irritate my eyes and no white cast! 10/10
Love this stuff! I'm on my 3rd or 4th bottle. It's super lightweight, absorbs quickly, doesn't leave a white cast and doesn't sting around the eyes. This is my go-to, year round.
Although it's a bit pricey, I absolutely LOVE this product! The consistency is amazing and a little goes a longggg ways. Will definitely be repurchasing!!!

I have dry skin and need to use many layers of hydration. As a result sunscreen often pills I've used some very high-end highly recommended sunscreens and they just all up and make a mess of my makeup. This is one of the few sunscreens that does not give me that problem goes on clear does not irritate eyes. Highly recommend recommended.

avis.titre: Worked great on my combo skin
avis.texte: This was one I'll continue to reach for. It didnt burn my eyes, was easy to put on, and left my skin looking like it was glowing from within. I also enjoyed that the packaging seemed to dispense the entirety of the product.

I have learned that I need different sunscreens based on the season so that I am comfortable and actually wear the sunscreen. This one is great for fall, a cool spring, and warm winter days. I am picky and I would not wear this on a hot spring day or in summer. You will not be moisturized by this so skin prep is a must. If you do a lot of moisturizing at night and your skin moisture levels are good then you could wear this out and about without other moisturizers or treatments underneath.

I wear this every single day as the last step to my skincare. It soaks in my skin so well. Very glowy at first! Just like a serum. No whitecast. Not sticky!! Daily wear for one year! Small bottle does last awhile, always buy two when on sale ☀️👏🏼⭐️
I absolutely adore the texture of this product. It goes on silky smooth, and dries down quickly. Wears nicely under makeup and feels good all day!

I have been using naked Sunday for months and I am in love with all the products. My last order was water serum and priming lotion, which I fell in love with. I have been using them every morning and makes my skin very smooth and healthy. Thank you naked Sunday.

avis.titre: Goes on great no residue or white wash
avis.texte: This is the sunscreen I have been looking for, gel based goes on well without feeling caked on and there's no white film over the face, it feels light. And at a high spf, there's good protection.
This is the best sunscreen I've tried. It feels like I'm just putting skincare on my face. I have rosacea and perioral dermatitis and it protected my skin and doesn't irritate it. I love it!

I havent been proactive when it comes to wearing sunscreen and decided to add it to my skincare routine. Im already obsessed with this product. The smell is very light and not overbearing. It does not feel greasy even after I've applied serums and moisturizer and doesnt take long to sink into the skin. No pilling whatsoever definitely a staple in my routine from now on! 10/10
Goes on really well over my moisturiser and before my makeup. Not oily at all.

I began purchasing Naked Sundays about two years ago on their website until Ulta began carrying some, not all of the products. I love this gel serum and on my sixth bottle. I have the travel size too. Goes on effortlessly and does not pill. Sometimes I mix a little of their skin tint with it on my face. The 3 products I use from this line is gel serum, face spray mist and skin tint (pearl, illuminating or nude). The spray is great for my ears as I have had basal cell cancer in my ear.
I love these lip oils! I have all of them & they are just my favorite! I would recommend these to everyone.
love ! very pretty and tastes good ! thank you for sending this extra surprise !

I struggle finding an SPF that works for my skin because I have very dry, acne prone skin. This feels like a serum and doesn't feel heavy at all and it makes my skin glow and I haven't had any breakouts.
Lightweight and perfect for under makeup. Just don't rub in for too long because that's when it starts to peel.
This has become my favorite gloss! It feels hydrating, its smooth and not sticky, and gives the most subtle but print hint of color. I've already purchased more!
This is my 3rd order. So easy to blend, no sting and my husband loves it.
Feels silky smooth under my makeup and gives my skin a glass like glow

I do not have any affiliations with this brand or this product. I usually only leave a review of some things exceptionally bad or exceptionally good. For me, this is exceptionally good. This is my favorite sunscreen.! it does well under make up. It sinks right into your skin. I maybe would not recommend it for oily skin however I'm not really sure. Maybe the oily skin girl can leave some more feedback on that. However, I will use this for as long as they have it in stock and continue to re-purchase. … Preferably when it's on sale. It goes on like a gel and then almost sink into your skin and kind of works like a primer for your make up, which is not something I can say about all my sunscreens

I love this sunscreen. It has a smooth texture, doesn't have a white cast, and doesn't burn my eyes! I love the fact that they created larger sizes bottles, as I go through this like crazy, because I reapply my sunscreen as I'm supposed to, but it doesn't make my skin greasy, doesn't break me out, and doesn't leave a weird film or smell badly. By far, one of my absolute favorite sunscreens.
Love having this as apart of my morning skin care routine! It's lightweight, hydrating and honestly just a nice reassurance. Can never be too sun-safe :)))

At first it seemed amazing. Very light with the texture of a serum... But this pills every time I use it, especially when I have on serum and moisturizer underneath. Then with the same serum and moisturizer my other sunscreens don't pill, it's just this one. It's so disappointing because the finish is initially nice! But alas I went off of reviews and this is so overrated and I'm not sure why. Maybe it doesn't pill off if you don't use anything else underneath? Idk but if you're putting sunscreen on bare skin only you're doing it wrong..
Hands down sunscreen ever! Looks great under make up. You get glass skin. I get so many compliments when i wear this product without make up. I do wear a moisturizer underneath

avis.titre: Lightweight, Invisible SPF That Feels Like Skincare
avis.texte: Lightweight, fast-absorbing, and truly invisibleâ€"no white cast or greasy feel. Works perfectly under makeup and feels hydrating without being heavy. Great daily SPF50 protection that actually feels good to wear. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Another Great product from Naked Sundays
avis.texte: Perfect choice for mature skin, doesn't enhance fine lines and wrinkles and works great under my foundation and on my neck and chest, non greasy
The lip oils are great but this flavour doesn't hit the mark for me, despite caramel being my favourite flavour. The pink one is by far the best
Salted caramel is my favourite..gorgeous glossy protection I take with me everywhere.
Love using this sunscreen, It's nice and light and doesn't feel sticky once it dries down. Love mixing it with the bronzing drops for a no makeup day.
Very good project and suitable for my sensitive oily skin without causing irritation or greasy marks

I have a few favorite spf products but this is the best one. It's clear, not greasy, absorbs and feels like a lightweight moisturizer, doesn't pill, works well with makeup ... You couldn't ask for a better sunscreen. Order it!

this is literally the BEST face sunscreen i've ever used, and i'm a daily wearer. tried them all, K-beauty, all natural/zinc, sensitive skin, all types-- and this is the ONLY i've ever had that does not get in your eyes and sting!! i literally rub this all over my face like its a gentle face lotion, and it wears amazingly! no burning, stinging, runny eyes, or makeup pilling. it's like the perfect primer under makeup, or just adds a lovely glow on makeup free days. plz never stop carrying this, ulta! new fave!!

I have been eyeing this off forever and finally purchased it. I've since been using it everyday and it is amazing. I've always struggled to find a sunscreen that sits well under my makeup and this is better than a primer. Love this stuff
I love the previous clear serum too. I wear this every day under makeup or by itself. Non-greasy and feels great on the skin.

I've used CeraVe's SPF30 moisturizer for years now. I have oily/combination skin, so trying new products is always a gamble. I noticed my CeraVe wasnt meshing with my skin well recently, so I decided to switch to this and I LOVE IT. It doesnt make me feel too greasy, and it gives me a perfect dewy look all day. It melts right into my skin so i dont have to rub harshly like i did with CeraVe. It doesn't have a strong scent either! I 100% recommend.

avis.titre: Great texture, blends well with other products!
avis.texte: Purchased this on a whim and I'm so glad I did. The texture is light and blends well with other products! An easy way to layer up on SPF. Feels great!
It's a solid lip oil; the scent is a big strong for me but it does diffuse.
I love all their product but this one is so great! You don't have to get your hands dirty

avis.titre: The only facial SPF i use!!
avis.texte: Sunscreen is a sensory NIGHTMARE to me. The smell, the texture, how my makeup sits on top, etc. always seems to bother me. This was the first facial sunscreen I've used that I was able to easily incorporate into my routine! It feels like a lightweight moisturizer and works as a great base under makeup. It's my all-time favorite, even above my $80 tatcha sunscreen. I'm obsessed! ❤️

I live in Florida and have been using this product for the last 10 months. Can't say enough good things about this product. I tend to break out using sunscreen daily, and have one of thise skin types when I use a new product within 24 hrs I will see a reaction like the dreaded pimple. This is light weight, non greasy, and works great under makeup. I would like to see a version for your entire body with this formula.
I think I like this serum. I've only used it a few times - it definitely doesn't feel like sunscreen & the Naked Sundays 50SPF foundation goes over it nicely
Was great under make up and for right in the morning headed to the beach!! Will Order again

I'm sceptical of the 50spf rating, but i wore this on a super sunny day and did not burn or even go pink. I wouldnt call it a gel, its a very thin, light lotion. Goes on beautifully and sits nicely on the skin. Leaves a more matte texture, rather than a dewy finish .

avis.titre: Real review from a real person
avis.texte: I love the water gel serum. Non-greasy and no white cast! Makeup goes on beautifully over it.

avis.titre: Cabana Clear Water Gel Serum SPF50
avis.texte: Like that it glides on clear and doesn't leave a white cast. Leave a dewy glow once on. I just tone the dew down a little with makeup, which once absorbed a little doesn't pill under my foundation.

This is an amazing product. Really pleasant smell not too overbearing like most SPF I've tried. Lightweight formula , pleasant feel on my skin. This is my first time trying this bland but I will definitely buy this product again.
Perfect for my vacation in Cuba! No sunburns, good taste, light Absolutely love it!
On my fourth bottle. Clean feeling alone or under tinted moisturizer

This sunscreen is incredible. I love the way it sits on my skin. It makes my foundation look smooth and beautiful. I love it however, I'm sad to report that it burns my skin. I tried it for about 4 days and every time I put it on my face burns. After reading all the reviews I noticed no one else has had an issue with burning so it might just be might sensitive skin. I'm so sad that I need to return it because I really love it but I can't deal with the burning.
This sunscreen is so light weight and perfect for travel! It also works great under makeup which is always appreciated
I LOVE!! has to be my favourite product, makes your skin glow being light weight anddidn't hurt my sensitive skin
Loved how clear it was and appreciated the pump applicator. Unfortunately it smelled like sunscreen and burned when I reapplied later on in the day

I struggle with sunscreen. Using Tret I know it's a must. Makeup won't sit right with me. Usually use mineral. Kept reading about this one. Bought 2. Let me tell you. Foundation sits perfect on top. No separation. No burning my eyes out of my head. And I have sensitive skin. Glad I bought 2!
My skin is sensitive and this doesn't irritate my skin as much as other sunscreens. It is easy to apply and rub into the skin, I can get this around my eyes as well.
This is the only sunscreen that doesn't leave that awful white cast or peeling. My skin feels moisturized but not weighed down. Which says a lot because I have extremely oily skin. Highly recommend.

The literal best spf and moisturizer I've ever used, It feels amazing on my skin. I layered it under the tinted beauty screen then use it for top ups throughout the day. Feels just like a serum... you won't feel like you're wearing SPF! Wear under makeup or on its own.

I purchased all the flavours. Beautiful application. Just the taste of the spf not the best, at least it will stop me from licking it or eating it off lips. Perfect Gloss and Tints on all, just can taste the spf.
I like this lip oil. It hydrates my lives good. The only thing I don't like as much about this is after you put in on you can kind of taste a sunscreen taste and It's not my favorite.

avis.titre: Great new addition to my skin care routine
avis.texte: I've been using the Naked Sundays Cabana Clear SPF, and I absolutely love it. It feels weightless on my skin..no white cast, no greasy residue, and it layers beautifully under makeup. I also appreciate that it doesn't clog my pores or leave that heavy sunscreen feel. It's perfect for everyday wear and gives me peace of mind knowing I'm protected without compromising how my skin looks or feels. Definitely a new staple in my routine!
I love this lip oil, only downside is it goes very quickly and you can't access the remaining amount at the bottom of the container

avis.titre: Amazing water gel serum with spf!
avis.texte: Very light weight and no fragrance or white cast! It's very hydrating and goes well under make up. Love love!
My favorite sunscreen. I hate the residue most facial sunscreens leave behind but I put this one on under my moisturizer because It's so lightweight and it hasn't pilled under makeup so far!
At 32yrs im obsessed with anything SPF - this oil is no exception. Part of the daily routine now.

I got this for free from Naked Sundays with my purchase and love it. I used it before an outdoor LA event where I was in the sun all day and this saved my lips. I reapplied a couple of times and it did it's job. And the smell is incredible.
So easy for a quick get ready. I have one in my purse for reapplication later in the day. Buying more!
wasn't expecting to like this lip oil so much. Already loving Naked Sundays and spf50 being in each product. doesn't feel sticky or oily. Use it every morning before work.

This is a great clear SPF lipgloss. Has a nice coconut taste and minimal SPF after taste. Does need to be reapplied regularly, and isn't super shiny, but excellent for outdoor wear none the less. Maybe a bit runny when it gets warm, but the doe foot applicator allows for good product control.
Really awesome SPF lip gloss. The colour was not quite right for me, but I do love how the formula wears. No gross SPF after taste and stays put. Does need to be reapplied as directed.

This stuff is really wonderful! The cream comes out white but it is totally clear. It doesn't smell, feels good on my skin and leaves me with a nice glow. It's not greasy at all and doesn't dry me out. It's a fantastic price point and a high SPF. I do tend to wear it on its own but I have layered it with other products (both skin care and makeup) and I had no issues with pilling. Highly, highly recommend getting this product!!!

This sunscreen is lightweight. It disappears into the skin within seconds and sits on the face beautifully. Medium/dark tones wonâ€™t have to worry about white cast or struggling to blend this spf. Best of all, itisn't the least bit greasy. I'm definitely repurchasing!ðŸ'—
Not greasy, but lets a nice sheen. No chapped lips while being in the sun!!
This lip oil is fantastic.....easy to apply.....not a fan of scented or flavoured products however this one is palatable.... Great moisture and most importantly SPF 50
I love this serum! I find that lotion sunscreens break me out and make my rosacea flare (red, itchy, hot skin). Thankfully, this serum doesn't cause any of this! Holy grail level product.
With a nice taste and color. Also not sticky like some gloss. My hair doesn't get stuck in it. Also protect from the wind as well as the sun. Great product. My third purchase.
This lip oil smells amazing and feels so great on the lips. Gives a nice tint of color and applicator is flexible so applies so nicely.

avis.titre: Nice clear sunscreen, not super hydrating
avis.texte: I like the texture of this; it's lightweight, has no smell, goes on clear, and makes my skin glow. The only reason I gave it 4 instead of 5 stars is that it's not as hydrating or moisturizing as I prefer with my SPF (I have dry-ish to combination skin depending on my area's humidity).

This has a really nice smell, it's long lasting, and looks great on. Although it's not a plumping lip product, I feel like it makes my lips look fuller. The watermelon color is a nice, natural looking sheer pink/red. My only complaint is that if you eat or drink while wearing this, it has a slightly odd taste.

I got this lip oil in a kit, and I wasn't all too excited about it because I normally use regular Chapstick, but I actually love this product and will order again. It's not sticky at all and it has a great flavor and is very moisturizing. Very surprised about how much I love this product.

This is by far the best US sunscreen, hands down, no competition. Silky smooth and hydrating. Easily spreadable, not stiff or hard to blend. Moisturizing and doesnt feel like a heavy sunscreen at all. Right now I have never tried anything better than this on the market.
